name: gr-income-tax
description: Greek personal income tax for tax year 2026 (calendar year, return filed in 2027) for all individuals: employees, pensioners, the self-employed and landlords. Covers the 2026 scale of ν. 5246/2025 (9% to 44%), the lower rates for parents and for under-30s, the tax reduction for salaries and pensions (EUR 777 upwards, by number of children), the minimum deemed income of the self-employed (arts. 28A to 28Γ, from ν. 5073/2023), the 2026 rental scale (15% to 45%), dividends 5%, interest 15%, royalties 20%, the 30% card-spending requirement, the abolished solidarity contribution, the E1 return in myAADE, eight instalments, the early-filing discount and the 55% prepayment. Trigger phrases: Greek income tax, φορολογική δήλωση, E1, how much tax in Greece, salary tax Greece, freelancer tax Greece, τεκμήρια, rental income Greece. Out of scope: moving in or out and non-residents (gr-cross-border), EFKA contributions (gr-efka for the self-employed, gr-employee-contributions for employees), company
